_comment: Decisions taken on the intake findings. A finding without an agreed decision is open; open high findings drive the risk status.

decisions.decision: Order, status and line items become one document, written atomically; the stock decrement and the order insert run in one multi-document transaction on the Atlas replica set
Order ids move to an atomic findOneAndUpdate($inc) on the sequences collection; id format unchanged
Keep legacy inner-join behaviour (accounts without a banner, orders without a status are not returned); parity tests pin it
Keep % and _ as wildcards in search for this release; product owner to decide on escaping afterwards
Money as Decimal128; totals reconciled after each migration rehearsal
